text: 小红书发布关于暑期安全旅行专项的治理公告：近期全国迎来暑期出游高峰，小红书从严治理社区内文旅行业内容与经营生态，主动提交黑灰产线索配合警方打击。今年4月，平台启动强迫购物整治专项，从严整治无资质旅游招徕和虚假宣传信息。七月以来，小红书持续加强对出行类相关内容和经营环境专项巡查，对“飞拉达““双石门““赛里木湖““英山斗笠沟“等热门户外景点做风险提示和搜索保障、针对以“旅行搭子““拼车拼团“等名义所虚假引流、欺诈产业链做线索摸排，对无资质经营的旅行社、工作室、个人账号从严巡查清理。上半年来，小红书配合多地警方抓捕以批量造假注册文旅票务、房地产、金融等行业专
text_en: Xiaohongshu Issues Notice on Special Summer Travel Safety Campaign: With the summer travel peak in full swing nationwide, Xiaohongshu is strictly regulating tourism-related content and business practices within its community, proactively submitting leads on black and grey industry operations to assist police in crackdowns. In April, the platform launched a special campaign against forced shopping, rigorously tackling unlicensed tourism solicitation and false advertising. Since July, Xiaohongshu has intensified special inspections of travel-related content and business environments, issuing risk alerts and search safeguards for popular outdoor attractions such as 'Ferrata,' 'Shuangshimen,' 'Sayram Lake,' and 'Yingshan Douligou,' investigating fake traffic and fraud chains under the guise of 'travel buddies' or 'carpooling and group tours,' and strictly cracking down on unlicensed travel agencies, studios, and personal accounts. In the first half of the year, Xiaohongshu cooperated with multiple local police forces to arrest individuals involved in batch-fabricated registrations for tourism ticketing, real estate, finance, and other industries.
